minutes.headline: ZBA approved a special permit for a used car dealership and auto repair shop at 36 Summer Street
minutes.summary:
The Zoning Board of Appeals heard a special permit application from the owners of Unique Motors Group to operate a used car dealership and auto repair business at 36 Summer Street, moving from a smaller Leominster location. After discussion of vehicle counts, setbacks, parking layout, flood-zone paving limits, and standard operating conditions (indoor repairs only, no outdoor storage, set business hours, lighting and noise controls), the board voted to grant the special permit with those conditions attached.</parameter>
</invoke>

what_happened.line: The Zoning Board of Appeals voted to grant a special permit for a used car dealership and auto repair shop at 36 Summer Street, with conditions attached.
The applicant agreed to cut the requested vehicle count and to keep the required 20-foot setback from Summer Street.
The board eliminated a rear parking area from the site plan for lack of room and required one side of the lot stay open for emergency vehicle access.
Because the property sits in a flood zone, any additional paving beyond what was approved would need a separate special permit from the planning board.

why_it_matters: A new used car dealership and repair shop is coming to Summer Street, operating under conditions covering hours, lighting, noise, and a no-outdoor-storage rule meant to limit impact on neighbors.
Residents near the site should expect the vehicle count and site layout described at the hearing, not the larger version originally proposed.
Any future request to pave more of the flood-zone lot would trigger its own public hearing at the planning board.
watch_next: Filing of the permit with the town clerk and recording at the registry of deeds; a 2-year lapse applies if the use is not established
